summary: Correct history fixtures to use valid severity and exact bounded lookup plans

replay.detail: Only authored control inputs and exact accepted plan strings change; no production or replay change.

schema.detail: The diagnostic severity registry remains warning or error; the three authored fixtures incorrectly used info and now use warning.

rules.detail: No rule, query, index or cardinality change. All candidate-count, covering-index, scan-refusal, sort-ancestor and row-bound assertions remain.

compatibility.detail: The plan control accepts only the named episode index SEARCH with id equality alone or with a rowid/store_index upper range, and rejects scans, another index and non-equality shapes. The production join cut has existed since e1236bec.

manual.detail: No runtime action or configuration change.

recovery.detail: Authored assertions are unrun until fresh hosted qualification and establish no native or rollout acceptance.
